answer: Charge each new identity a one-time compute relic: a proof-of-work admission whose bits rise with join pressure. Tie rewards to a graded kernel of original challenge answers judged by established peers, with payouts vesting over many epochs so throwaway farms cannot cash out fast. Tag recruits with a saffron referral graph that zeros kin-linked clones, so only outside agents pay the recruiter—raising the real cost of spinning a sybil swarm.
